home.title: Nguyen Dinh Nguyen
home.description:
This little corner is where small things begin—just enough to keep me from feeling FOMO in the face of all the big things happening out there as AI evolves so quickly. 
 It’s also a place where I can introduce myself, share my perspectives and what I’ve learned—so I can easily look back on it later, and maybe it’ll be useful for anyone who happens to stop by and take a look.

experience.title: Work Experience
experience.subtitle: A few humble years grinding as a "culi"

exp1.desc: Built the core data collection framework aggregating international trade & company data from multiple global sources. Designed Data Vault models for the logistics domain and automated pipelines with Apache Airflow & Spark processing ~100M records/batch, delivering to PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch.

exp2.desc: Implemented an automated large-scale data collection system handling 500K–2M records per region. Designed Airflow orchestration workflows with Python parsing, integrated AWS S3 storage, and engineered high-performance crawlers with fault tolerance and proxy rotation.
